title: Pumpkin Spice Old Fashioned
description: This Pumpkin Spice Old-Fashioned Cocktail is filled with fall flavor. Real pumpkin, fall spices and Kentucky bourbon are a winning trio, and homemade pumpkin spice syrup is the secret to this fabulous fall drink.
ingredients: 16 dashes cinnamon or orange or Angustura bitters
½ cup cane sugar or granulated sugar
directions: In a rocks glass, add pumpkin spice syrup and top with bourbon.
Carefully spoon in the ice cube or sphere.
Add the dashes of bitters, to taste.
Garnish with an orange peel and cinnamon stick.
In a saucepan over medium heat, stir together sugars and water until the sugar has dissolved. Don’t let it boil.
Stir in pumpkin purée and vanilla extract until combined. Stir in the spices.
Cook for about 10 minutes total, being careful not to boil. Turn off the heat and let the mixture sit for 15 minutes.
Strain through a fine mesh strainer.
Store in a glass jar for up to 2 weeks.
